title: Saturating Accumulator
statement: Implement an 8-bit accumulator that adds an 8-bit input to its stored value when enable is high and saturates at maximum/minimum values on overflow. It must update on the rising edge of clk and support synchronous reset. This block demonstrates arithmetic accumulation with overflow handling in a datapath.
module_signature: module saturating_accumulator(input clk, input rst, input en, input signed [7:0] d, output reg signed [7:0] q);
behavior: On clk rising edge, if en is 1 add d to q and saturate on overflow.
If en is 0, q retains its value.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous reset or latches.
hint: Detect signed overflow when adding q and d.
